market.title: Chaos is visible.
market.intro: Trading Monks is an independent equity research practice led by **Manas Budhiraja**. We connect price structure, volume participation and business fundamentals into structured research views — each with its risk parameters defined from the start.

concepts.name: Market structure
concepts.text: Price behaviour at support, resistance and consolidation zones — read before any view is formed.

concepts.name: Research discipline
concepts.text: Technical structure is checked against volume participation, business quality and the wider market environment.

concepts.name: Risk awareness
concepts.text: Invalidation levels and exposure boundaries are defined before an opportunity is pursued.

philosophy.copy: Markets move. Emotions fluctuate. Our philosophy begins with a commitment to process, research and disciplined decision-making.

principles.title: Research
principles.text: Decisions informed by price geometry and volume participation, never speculative market noise.

principles.title: Discipline
principles.text: A non-negotiable process that neutralises greed and fear, ensuring consistency across market cycles.

principles.title: Risk Awareness
principles.text: Invalidation boundaries and asymmetric payoff profiles defined explicitly before capital is committed.

strategy.title: One system.
strategy.intro: Research is not a feeling. It is a sequence — each stage with its own inputs, checks and stated limits.

stages.name: Observe
stages.label: PRICE / LEVELS / CONTEXT
stages.title: First, remove the noise.
stages.text: Read price behaviour at support, resistance and consolidation zones. Map the structure before forming a view.

stages.name: Validate
stages.label: VOLUME / TREND / FUNDAMENTALS
stages.title: Conviction needs evidence.
stages.text: Study volume participation, trend strength, earnings and balance-sheet quality, and the broader market environment.

stages.name: Structure
stages.label: ENTRY / INVALIDATION / PARAMETERS
stages.title: Define the downside first.
stages.text: Set out entry zones, invalidation levels and research parameters. A perspective is incomplete without them.

stages.name: Define risk
stages.label: EXPOSURE / VOLATILITY / EVENTS
stages.title: Boundaries before conviction.
stages.text: Downside exposure, volatility, liquidity and event risk are stated explicitly in every research view.

stages.name: Review
stages.label: MONITOR / REASSESS / DISCLOSE
stages.title: A view is never final.
stages.text: Published perspectives are monitored against their stated parameters and reassessed when the structure changes.

strategy.finePrint: Trading Monks provides independent equity research under SEBI Research Analyst registration. It does not execute trades or manage client capital. Chart is illustrative and does not represent a past or future recommendation.

governance.copy: We don't publish a decorative performance curve, because a retrospective chart is a promise no analyst can make. What we can show is who is behind the research, how it is regulated, and how every view is structured.

items.question: Do you file the SEBI application on my behalf?
items.answer: No. The application must be filed by you. We prepare the checklist, review documents and guide you through every step.

items.question: Is this a substitute for a compliance auditor?

items.question: What capital is required?
items.answer: Hedged index structures need the margin your broker specifies, which varies with the structure. Check with your broker before subscribing.

items.question: Do you recommend naked option selling?
items.answer: No. Every structure we publish is hedged so that the maximum loss is known in advance.

items.question: What if I miss an adjustment update?
items.answer: Each structure has a pre-defined stop at the structure level, so a missed update does not leave risk undefined.

optionSelling.disclaimer: Trading in derivatives involves substantial risk of loss. As per SEBI's study, 9 out of 10 individual traders in equity F&O incurred net losses. Research does not guarantee profit.

optionBuying.summary: Selective, directional option buying research with strict premium-at-risk limits and time-based exits.
optionBuying.seoDescription: Selective directional option buying research on index and stock options, with premium-at-risk limits, time stops and structured exits.

hero.title: Fewer trades.
hero.intro: Directional option buying research only when **momentum, structure and volatility** line up — with the premium at risk capped before entry.
hero.note: Option premiums can decay to zero. Only risk capital you can afford to lose.

overview.title: Buying options is about timing.
overview.text: Option buyers fight time decay on every trade. We only publish views when a **breakout or reversal is confirmed by volume** and implied volatility is reasonable — and we exit on time if the move does not come.

audience.title: Small-capital participants
audience.text: Traders who prefer a fixed, known maximum loss — the premium paid.

audience.title: Momentum traders
audience.text: Participants who want structured, event-aware directional setups.

audience.title: Learners of option Greeks
audience.text: Traders who want to understand delta, theta and IV through real research notes.

items.question: Is option buying safer than selling?
items.answer: The maximum loss is limited to the premium paid, but the probability of losing that premium is high. Neither is safe — size accordingly.

items.question: Are setups intraday or positional?
items.answer: Both. Each note clearly states its expected holding window and time-based exit.

items.question: Can I follow with small capital?
items.answer: Yes, but we recommend never risking more than a small percentage of your trading capital on any single premium.
